definition: The task of assigning predefined categories or labels to a piece of text.
details: Text classification underlies many practical NLP applications, including spam detection, topic categorization, and content moderation, and can be tackled with anything from simple classical ML models to fine-tuned transformer models.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. Think of it this way: The task of assigning predefined categories or labels to a piece of text. And here is the clever part: Text classification underlies many practical NLP applications, including spam detection, topic categorization, and content moderation, and can be tackled with anything from simple classical ML models to fine-tuned transformer models. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Text Classification — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
